g.text: Silence is only one observable pattern
26 completed games / 1,029 evaluable agent-rounds / GPT-5.4, plan-elicited / 08 Sep 2026
Dots = individual games • Shaded bars and solid ticks = pooled agent-round rates
Descriptive only: rounds within games are dependent. Right panel shows candidates, not verified omissions.
Neither endpoint establishes recipient ignorance, causal motives or harm. Eleven invalid communication rows are excluded.
